high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "beautifuldestinations," located in Copenhagen, Denmark. The post features an aerial view of a residential area with a unique architectural design. The houses are surrounded by meticulously trimmed hedges that form circular patterns, creating a visually striking and symmetrical layout. The setting appears to be a suburban neighborhood, with each house having its own small garden or yard. The hedges are well-maintained, with some areas featuring flowering plants, adding pops of color to the greenery.
